title: Multi-tab sync gap — marking read in Tab A not reflected in Tab B without reload
`getNotificationColor` maps legacy enum values ('alert'/'warning'/'success') — current `notificationType` never matches — all notifications render blue
description:
**File:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/notifications/NotificationMenu.js` (and `NotificationMenu_chakra.js`)
**Line:** 43–53
**Root Cause:** `getNotificationColor(notification.type)` passes `notification.type` (the legacy DB field, set to the `notificationType` value by `dispatch()`) and the switch checks 'alert' | 'warning' | 'success'. Actual `notificationType` enum values are 'task_assigned', 'general', 'evidence_approved', 'evidence_rejected', 'deadline_approaching', 'review_reminder', etc. No match is ever found — always falls through to `default: 'blue.500'`.
**Impact:** All notifications render blue regardless of urgency. High-priority 'evidence_rejected' and 'deadline_approaching' items cannot be visually differentiated from routine 'general' items.
**Fix:** Update switch cases to match the actual `notificationType` enum (red for rejected/deadline, orange for reminders, green for approved) and pass `notification.notificationType` instead of `notification.type`.
fixEvidence: Both menu files: switch cases updated to 'evidence_rejected'/'deadline_approaching'/'review_reminder'/'evidence_approved'; arg changed to `notification.notificationType`
